p1_definition: All MEDIUM findings in the 2026-09-30 A01-A20 master audit inventory.

tracks.P1-01: Repository authority, reproducibility, reviewer bootstrap and route source truth
tracks.P1-02: Typed transaction semantics and all-canon semantic assurance
tracks.P1-07: Economics, treasury, rewards and fee integrity
tracks.P1-10: Claims truth, repository messaging and browser credential custody

findings.summary: Authoritative main branch does not enforce the validation gates
findings.evidence: Repository administration closure verified after PR #40. Active repository ruleset `WeAll Audit Closure Standard` (ruleset 24625129), targeting `~DEFAULT_BRANCH`, requires pull requests, linear history, and required status contexts `backend`, `web`, `secrets_guard`, and `reviewer-readiness`; it prohibits deletion and non-fast-forward updates, has no bypass actors, and reports current_user_can_bypass=`never`. Positive control: PR #40 merged at 2026-10-07T02:54:21Z after all four required checks succeeded on exact head 35f0c48770fb812ae5aec894cadf1830f4f32a4d. Negative control: PR #41, based on main 94ea935eb039f484bd735cbb1d62b500e47ad314, intentionally made only generated/current_verified_claims.json stale; required `backend` failed at generated-artifact freshness, reviewer-readiness and focused-p1 also failed, GitHub reported mergeable_state=`blocked`, and the PR was closed unmerged. Together these establish required-check enforcement on authoritative main with explicit no-bypass policy.

findings.summary: Clean checkout proof is not a clean-machine/hermetic reproducibility proof
findings.evidence: The audit explicitly allowed scoping the clean-checkout claim instead of claiming a hermetic machine. `docs/reviewer/START_HERE.md` and `docs/V2_SPEC_COMPILER.md` now define `check_v2_spec_clean_checkout.py` as source-archive consistency under an already-provisioned toolchain and explicitly disclaim byte-for-byte clean-machine/container/toolchain hermeticity. Assurance reconciliation run 37551824457 regenerated exact-tree derivatives, reproduced all 42 V2 derivatives from a clean Git archive, and passed the claim-scope regressions on workflow-free commit 6cfa4f971f08d1508690f89d1ab06730894f37a4 / tree f7777d0a485e5815757efdb7a4076f3df1debb6c.

findings.summary: Generated V2 route inventory includes four unmounted duplicate endpoint implementations
findings.evidence: Dormant decorated node-discovery wrappers were removed from src/weall/api/routes_nodes.py, leaving that module helper-only and src/weall/api/routes_public_parts/nodes.py as the sole decorated authority for GET /v1/nodes, /known, /seeds, and /validators. The V2 route inventory now requires 159 implementation rows, 159 unique method/path keys, and zero duplicate implementation rows. Regression coverage proves each affected node route is declared exactly once by nodes_router and that routes_public mounts that router exactly once under /v1; the generated V2 inventory has zero duplicate implementation rows, and no generated node route points to the retired helper-only routes_nodes.py module. Existing node endpoint TestClient coverage proves the mounted routes execute. Closure run 37402369877 passed route compiler, mounted API, clean-checkout, dependent evidence, and web dependency gates before producing workflow-free candidate fb929491b83cee8315534cd5c18f05dfb975a6e0 / tree 78a8a3056f8c3b01a87007dbcaf8c843e528a174.

findings.summary: Schema accepts textual false while social execution applies it as true
findings.evidence: Strict JSON boolean semantics are enforced for FOLLOW_SET, BLOCK_SET, and MUTE_SET at both schema and apply boundaries. The 3x8 coercion matrix rejects textual/integers and preserves real booleans; invalid direct apply leaves state unchanged. Reconciliation run 37394764328 registered invalid_payload:boolean_required, refreshed all three V2 semantic bindings, regenerated dependent evidence twice, passed clean-checkout V2/public-claim checks, and pushed workflow-free candidate 41c10839a3aeb965147006ca57ea5f089096b751.

findings.summary: Nonzero stale ledger snapshot can pass startup while newer persisted blocks already exist
findings.evidence: Workflow-free A03 reconciliation run 37533819920 produced exact candidate 7e7094a0eb01ac555a0fb47700c6885f61f1cffb / tree dfffac682b4ae22a7d0abf420fdc6c2de7087324. Startup now fails closed whenever a non-genesis ledger snapshot height differs from the highest persisted canonical block height. The regression matrix covers fresh/normal restart, zero-behind, nonzero stale snapshot behind newer blocks, snapshot ahead of block history, pruned-history checkpoint fallback, state-sync checkpoint restart, and persisted tip corruption. The reconciliation also passed two-pass evidence regeneration and clean-checkout verification.

findings.summary: Observer durable_tx_queue acknowledgement is not backed by an explicit filesystem durability barrier
findings.evidence: Workflow-free A03 reconciliation run 37533819920 produced exact candidate 7e7094a0eb01ac555a0fb47700c6885f61f1cffb / tree dfffac682b4ae22a7d0abf420fdc6c2de7087324. Observer durable_tx_queue publication now flushes and fsyncs replacement file contents, atomically renames, and fsyncs the parent directory on the supported POSIX production posture. Focused evidence proves file_fsync -> replace -> directory_fsync ordering, file-fsync failure prevents publication, and directory-fsync failure propagates so the caller cannot acknowledge a durable handoff.

findings.summary: Timeout certificates do not actually identify the highest referenced QC
findings.evidence: Timeout messages now sign and carry authenticated high_qc_view plus the referenced QC object; accept/restart revalidation independently verifies QC signatures, epoch/set binding, block identity, and claimed view before ranking by actual QC view with deterministic QC-ID tie-break. A05 adversarial evidence covers stale-reference plurality losing to a higher honest QC, same-view conflicting-QC deterministic selection, signed forged-rank rejection, restart revalidation, four-node reordered partition/recovery convergence, embedded verified-QC recovery without trusting a local cache, old-generation restart filtering, and delayed timeout replay. Formatting/targeted proof run: 37536454048. This row is pushed only after the same workflow-free candidate passes regenerated evidence, full pytest, and Reviewer Readiness.

findings.summary: Future constitutional-slot blocks are rejected by honest construction but accepted by follower/BFT admission before the slot
findings.evidence: BFT block admission and follower replay now enforce the same constitutional physical not-before rule used by honest block construction. The focused regression proves a positive-genesis controlled clock rejects at not_before_ms-1 and accepts at the boundary, and instruments both BFT admission and follower replay to prove enforce_not_before=true. P1 Revalidation run 37543184561 passed on 9f23c293b06272c0bb140421c05f85ccff95396b / tree ede5568202f6f3ca9880ff825659d114911aa2dd.

findings.summary: Production TLS peer connections can silently disable certificate verification
findings.evidence: Production TLS transport fails closed without a CA unless the explicit WEALL_NET_TLS_INSECURE_OK compatibility override is set. The regression remained green in the combined A10/A13 reconciliation run 37394044969 before workflow-free candidate 00619c3892753f0da7b161a44666c2145b8ce4f0 was pushed.

findings.summary: Fresh async PoH can progress using commitment-only evidence with no cryptographically bound reviewable ciphertext
findings.evidence: Post-P0 production human-authority scope lock prevents fresh async/Tier-2/Live positive authority transitions and schedulers; exact branch workflow run 37383418894 passed tests/test_p0_06_production_scope_closure.py.

findings.summary: Anti-Sybil/collusion scoring exists as rehearsal/library logic but is not automatically enforced by the canonical PoH lifecycle
findings.evidence: Post-P0 production human-authority scope lock prevents canonical positive human-authority progression while uniqueness/entropy work remains unresolved; exact branch workflow run 37383418894 passed tests/test_p0_06_production_scope_closure.py.

findings.summary: Reward scheduler reallocates empty-bucket and split remainder value to the protocol treasury
findings.evidence: A10-F003 launch-scope closure is bound to reconciliation run 37397850376 and workflow-free candidate edfbf5aa5b8f2786de0858fdd57351c5a9618cb9 / tree fe86ddc7d14b1a0f494c7a16e23f68bd4c1f0db8. The known-legacy reward allocator is consensus-unreachable when replicated chain_id is weall-prod or weall-testnet-v1, independent of WEALL_MODE/operator environment; local/noncanonical fixtures retain the compatibility scheduler. The run passed launch-chain scope regressions, legacy epoch-scheduler compatibility, valid signed A15 registration-work admission under the explicitly allowed public-testnet ML-DSA posture while preserving production scarcity parameters, BLOCK_REWARD_MINT/BLOCK_REWARD_DISTRIBUTE semantic refresh, two deterministic regeneration rounds, clean-checkout V2 verification, B528/B534/B567/public-readiness/claim freshness, and workflow-free push. This disposition does not claim the final Candidate 3.11 accepted-work/public-goods/reserve/rotating-remainder allocation is implemented; live reward scheduling on launch identities remains closed until that contract is implemented and reviewed.

findings.summary: Generic treasury cancellation is authorized by a global emissary role rather than treasury-scoped cancellation authority
findings.evidence: TREASURY_SPEND_CANCEL is now canon-gated by treasury-scoped Signer authority, and the treasury applier independently checks the proposal-time allowed_signers snapshot (or derives a scoped legacy set) before mutation. The adversarial regression proves a globally seated non-signer emissary cannot cancel another treasury's spend. Reconciliation run 37394044969 refreshed TX-0506 semantics, regenerated dependent evidence twice, passed clean-checkout verification, and pushed workflow-free candidate 00619c3892753f0da7b161a44666c2145b8ce4f0. Because the canon change updates tx_index_hash, production genesis and chain-manifest commitments were deterministically rebuilt with the existing founder/account public keys, genesis time, unlock period, and bootstrap expiry; rebind run 37395566356 passed production manifest checks, both local observer gates, clean-checkout V2/public-claim freshness, and pushed candidate 3063c17a4549479b3b3f67c9decfd42299c9db5d.

findings.summary: Positive FEE_PAY can remove balance value without a destination or explicit burn accounting
findings.evidence: Positive FEE_PAY without an explicit disposition now fails atomically with fee_destination_required; destination-backed fees remain conserving. Remediation workflow run 37383826940 passed the new focused regressions, existing economics alignment tests, and canon sanity before committing the repair.

findings.summary: Positive transfer fee policy is currently unenforceable
findings.evidence: Configured positive BALANCE_TRANSFER fees are now settled atomically in the transfer transition: sender is debited amount+fee, recipient and canonical fee sink are credited, settlement is bound to deterministic transfer_id, missing sink/insufficient total funds fail closed, and replay dedupes before re-charge. A standalone zero/wrong FEE_PAY cannot authorize bypass. Reconciliation run 37391108169 passed targeted economics regressions, semantic refresh, two regeneration rounds, clean-checkout V2/B528/B534/B567/public-claim freshness, and pushed workflow-free candidate 08fd14aff62921ee505bfd21ae35de6c5bc7772f. Receipt compatibility was subsequently tightened so zero-fee BALANCE_TRANSFER preserves the pre-existing exact receipt shape while positive-fee transfers still expose fee settlement metadata; reconciliation run 37396195608 passed atomic-fee tests plus the full transfer-tip compatibility contract, refreshed BALANCE_TRANSFER semantics, regenerated evidence twice, verified clean checkout, and pushed workflow-free candidate d57e8dacd13fdfae65fb2e22617b6e8da7c241ed.

findings.summary: Anonymous mempool status returns complete pending transaction envelopes despite a redacted-public contract
findings.evidence: Public /v1/status/mempool now projects a strict allowlist of pending transaction metadata and excludes payload/signature contents. Secret-marker regression plus existing status diagnostics and canon checks passed in remediation workflow 37384931649; implementation commit 652f8dd81b036cb4527826ca828d5334745375be.

findings.summary: Observer-edge operator authorization trusts loopback peers by default
findings.evidence: Production observer-edge operator authorization no longer trusts loopback peers by default: missing/bad token loopback requests are rejected and only the configured token passes, while dev-only convenience remains explicitly bounded. The regression remained green in combined reconciliation run 37394044969.

findings.summary: Alternate encodings of the same ML-DSA key are treated as different protocol authorities
findings.evidence: A13-F001 canonical authority reconciliation run 37525717489 passed the real ML-DSA encoding matrix (hex/uppercase/Base64/unpadded/URL-safe variants -> one decoded-byte fingerprint and key ID), duplicate-add rejection without failed-tx mutation, recovery independence and historical freshness across aliases, alias-wide targeted revocation, deterministic historical alias migration, JSON restart/state-sync shape preservation, surrounding account/recovery regressions, crypto-posture regeneration, refresh of all 18 Identity V2 semantic bindings, two deterministic dependent-evidence regeneration rounds, clean-checkout V2/B528/B534/B567/public-readiness/current-claim verification, and workflow-free push. Exact candidate: 3b32f32b4345897d7f94289d767f7471d721630b / tree 0cf6a9ce2c2dd120b0bff47994e3b633ce3abe72.

findings.summary: Signature-profile mode policy and explicit allowlist can fail open to ML-DSA
findings.evidence: Runtime signature-profile admission enforces registry mode flags and explicit allowlists are authoritative: empty, unknown-only, and mixed-invalid policies fail closed rather than restoring pq-mldsa-v1; mainnet rejects ML-DSA while registry mainnet permission is false, while controlled/public testnet remains explicitly allowed. Transaction, block, validator/operator, and public-testnet caller matrices passed, and combined reconciliation run 37394044969 regenerated exact-tree evidence before pushing candidate 00619c3892753f0da7b161a44666c2145b8ce4f0.

findings.summary: An older persisted read can overwrite a newer committed in-memory canonical state
findings.evidence: A14-F001 branch-linearized publication reconciliation run 37526882786 passed the forced persisted-read/real block-commit N→N+1 interleaving, same-height wrong-tip + validator-generation publication ordering, existing BFT stale-persistence merge regression, checkpoint signing/canonical checkpoint atomicity, and mempool/checkpoint race tests. read_state now holds the canonical branch RLock across persisted read and self.state publication. Source-bound V2/release evidence regenerated twice from the workflow-free tree and clean-checkout/current-claim verification passed. Exact candidate: 3d872a5caf26d73cd88fae46751856e67d9fd826 / tree ad2101add49b9ccb249664abf7d3fb4767a022ee.

findings.summary: Health/readiness endpoints are rate-limit-exempt but load and parse the entire ledger snapshot
findings.evidence: Exact-head A01-A20 P1 Revalidation run 37532409647 passed tests/test_p1_a15_health_bounded_telemetry.py. Health/readiness telemetry uses the constant-size durable head query instead of loading/parsing the full ledger state; 500 repeated probes performed zero full-state reads, health does not wait on the BFT/checkpoint branch lock, and production compose/runbook evidence keeps health on the private operator boundary.

findings.summary: Public state snapshot has unbounded response/work size and recursively copies/redacts the whole state
findings.evidence: The O(total-state) /v1/state/snapshot projection is scope-closed from production before executor/state access; dev/test retains the redacted convenience route. The regression proves a legacy enable attempt cannot reopen the production path and that rejected production calls perform zero state reads. P1 Revalidation run 37543184561 passed on 9f23c293b06272c0bb140421c05f85ccff95396b / tree ede5568202f6f3ca9880ff825659d114911aa2dd.

findings.summary: A02 apply-failed replay defect is an indefinitely reusable block-capacity exhaustion primitive
findings.evidence: P0-01 made canonical failed user inclusion one-shot by consuming nonce and preserving committed identity semantics; exact branch workflow run 37383418894 passed the focused one-shot regression and the broader P0 overlap regression suite.

findings.summary: Transaction coverage is structural; no all-236 semantic property/mutation matrix exists
findings.evidence: All-236 semantic assurance is now executable and machine-readable. generated/tx_semantic_assurance_v1_5.json contains exactly 236 canonical rows, each with a schema-valid baseline, adversarial schema-rejection mutation, coercion probe, and required execution properties. tests/test_a16_f006_all_tx_semantic_assurance.py requires raw-vs-schema-normalized semantic parity, bounded-rollback versus deepcopy-oracle parity, and exact rollback equality on rejected execution for every canonical transaction. Initial run 37556225303 found two genuine survivors (POH_ASYNC_EVIDENCE_DECLARE default-metadata policy drift and REPUTATION_DELTA_APPLY journal-proxy-dependent event_history_root); both runtime causes were repaired without weakening the matrix. Run 37556616170 then generated and passed all 236 rows with zero survivors. Run 37556858369 regenerated the tracked manifest from a workflow-free tree, reran the entire 236-row matrix, committed candidate 0f9513f5b4d1e211f0fd58ead15e55cc6ea9f3af / tree d517dbb43f2d017e64721dd28d1169f22747e359, and verified manifest --check plus the full matrix from that committed candidate. Backend CI and A01-A20 P1 Revalidation now permanently require manifest freshness; the coverage report is scoped to this bounded semantic assurance and explicitly does not claim exhaustive all-state conformance.

findings.summary: Full reviewer-readiness reproduction depends on Git history, not only the current source archive
findings.evidence: The reviewer input/provenance contract now explicitly distinguishes a full-history clone from a historyless source archive. `restore_m2_m3_evidence_from_git.sh` preflights the exact required historical commit objects and fails with exact missing-SHA guidance, while `check_v2_spec_clean_checkout.py` proves only the archive-compatible derivative subset. `tests/test_p1_a17_reviewer_repro_contract.py` plus assurance reconciliation run 37551824457 passed on exact workflow-free commit 6cfa4f971f08d1508690f89d1ab06730894f37a4 / tree f7777d0a485e5815757efdb7a4076f3df1debb6c.

findings.summary: Application lockfiles do not make the full clean-machine build hermetic
findings.evidence: Full byte-for-byte clean-machine/toolchain hermeticity is intentionally not claimed. The canonical reviewer front door now distinguishes dependency-reproducible application install, source-archive derivative reproducibility, and full-history reviewer provenance, and explicitly lists mutable external selectors (base-image/tool image tags, Python/Node version families, GitHub Action major refs) as outside the archive proof. This closes the overbroad reproducibility scope without asserting immutable toolchain bytes; regression evidence passed in run 37551824457 on commit 6cfa4f971f08d1508690f89d1ab06730894f37a4.

findings.summary: Current clean CI proves source/install/test health but not complete node restart/replay reproducibility
findings.evidence: A new two-process lifecycle regression now crosses a real OS-process boundary over the same durable SQLite database: process 1 submits via API and commits @alice, exits, process 2 reloads persisted state/tx status, proves height/tip/state-root equivalence, submits @bob, commits the next block, and verifies continued durable state. Together with the existing in-process API/restart test, this passed in assurance reconciliation run 37551824457 on workflow-free commit 6cfa4f971f08d1508690f89d1ab06730894f37a4 / tree f7777d0a485e5815757efdb7a4076f3df1debb6c. Scope is local node process restart/replay, not a public/multimachine claim.

findings.summary: Current verified-claims registry cannot invalidate itself from same-tree adversarial findings
findings.evidence: Current-claims generation now consumes the active 34-finding P1 matrix as a same-tree hashed input, exposes open MEDIUM finding IDs through AUDIT-P1-001, and blocks stronger release boundaries while any P1 finding remains open. The parser validates the authoritative matrix schema/source/track contract, rejects summary drift, and treats pending_revalidation/design_blocker/open as claim-blocking states. A01-A20 P1 Revalidation run 37543738888 passed the strengthened self-invalidation tests.

findings.summary: Verified-human tier wording omits the critical uniqueness/Sybil limitation at the point of claim
findings.evidence: Exact-head A01-A20 P1 Revalidation run 37532409647 passed tests/test_p1_a18_claim_boundaries.py. The README PoH checkpoint colocates Tier 1/2 review-status wording with scope_closed_pending_uniqueness_entropy and the explicit statement that these tiers are not proof of global one-human uniqueness; the checkpoint also rejects reintroduction of 'verified human' shorthand.

findings.summary: Public repository description overstates exact canon conformance
findings.evidence: Public GitHub repository metadata now uses the bounded description: `WeAll Protocol reference node and specifications. Tx Canon is the intended canonical transaction contract; conformance is continuously tested and remains subject to audit.` The prior unqualified `code conforms to canon` assertion is gone. The technical prerequisites are also closed on the merged P1 tree: A02 strict-boolean semantic disagreement is repaired and the permanent all-236 semantic assurance gate reports all 236 canonical transaction vectors current. PR #40 exact-head required checks passed before merge. This closes the reviewer-first-impression overstatement without promoting a stronger semantic-conformance claim.

findings.summary: Advertised one-command tester node is not a self-contained clean-clone bootstrap
findings.evidence: The tester-node contract is now explicitly a one-command start after prerequisites rather than a blank-machine installer. The runbook requires a hash-locked backend virtualenv plus bundle/Genesis inputs, and the script fails closed if the prepared .venv is absent or npm is missing for the default frontend path. Shell syntax and source-contract regressions passed in P1 Revalidation run 37543184561 on 9f23c293b06272c0bb140421c05f85ccff95396b / tree ede5568202f6f3ca9880ff825659d114911aa2dd.

findings.summary: fresh_clone_smoke.sh can pass without exact-commit binding or frontend verification
findings.evidence: fresh_clone_smoke.sh now requires WEALL_FRESH_CLONE_COMMIT as an exact 40-hex commit, checks out that immutable subject detached, records commit and tree, installs the locked dev environment, runs full pytest, and requires frontend npm install/typecheck/production-safety/build with PASS_FULL_STACK and no skipped components. P1 Revalidation run 37543184561 passed on 9f23c293b06272c0bb140421c05f85ccff95396b / tree ede5568202f6f3ca9880ff825659d114911aa2dd.

findings.summary: Reviewer verification paths are fragmented and non-equivalent without a front-door decision tree
findings.evidence: docs/reviewer/START_HERE.md is now the canonical reviewer verification decision tree and is linked from the root README. It explicitly distinguishes full-history exact review, historyless archive checks, exact-commit fresh-clone smoke, external observer/onboarding, and local dev/demo paths and states their non-equivalence. Source-contract regressions passed in P1 Revalidation run 37543184561 on 9f23c293b06272c0bb140421c05f85ccff95396b / tree ede5568202f6f3ca9880ff825659d114911aa2dd.

findings.summary: Raw API session bearer key is persisted in browser localStorage
findings.evidence: Durable localStorage now retains non-secret session metadata only; the reusable bearer is tab/session-scoped in sessionStorage, legacy persistent bearers are scrubbed/migrated, and logout clears the bearer. Custody source proof, existing account-custody checks, TypeScript typecheck and Vite build all passed in workflow 37385473272; implementation commit 8750238534cfdeabacc9e30d7007ff6dde1ef3fb.
